session_selection: Query metadata for the exact identity; never change session, driver or compound when access/quality is insufficient.
stint_selection: Earliest chronological MEDIUM stint with at least six independently quality-passing complete laps. First three are adaptation, next three test; quality-only chronological replacement, never residual/pace selection.

alignment.method: Global proper similarity, global control-line phase and global location/car clock offset fitted with calibration-only integrated speed; no per-lap start subtraction or span stretching. Frozen projection branch resolved with speed integral only.
alignment.brake_interpolation: previous valid value, discrete zero-order hold

geometry.bounds_source: Frozen TUM centreline left/right widths; not surveyed 2026 FIA boundaries
geometry.coordinate_mapping: Legacy approximate FIA and aero locations are mapped through the same source-parameter/arc-length transform.

training_gate: Convergence, physics, mesh, both development modes and both new-session test modes must all pass before three-seed BC/DAgger. No expanded SAC.
limitations: No observed battery SOC, ERS split, pressure, precise racing line or aero states
Replay power/braking parameters are equivalent, not team measurements
FP2 transfer is condition-adapted same-circuit transfer, not cross-track generalization
